algorithm.candidate: big-endian first 4 digest bytes masked with 0x7fffffff
algorithm.accept: candidate is nonzero and absent from all earlier partitions
algorithm.collision: increment nonce from zero until accepted

partitions.name: e4_future_holdout
partitions.materialization_rule: only after a committed E3 failure analysis and before any version-2 implementation

disjointness: all materialized and future partitions are pairwise disjoint
holdout_access: development and training tools must reject validation and E3/E4 holdout seeds; validation tools reject E3/E4 seeds
